x-comment: Development only: GNOME Builder or flatpak-builder run the .Devel build from this tree.
Releases are native (meson install, build-aux/aur/PKGBUILD). Flathub is out of scope:
playback needs the host's Google Chrome (its Widevine plays Apple's protected streams),
which a Flathub app may not depend on, and the name and ID carry Apple's trademark.
The sandboxed app runs that Chrome through flatpak-spawn --host, hence the
org.freedesktop.Flatpak talk-name; the Chrome profile under ~/.var/app is the same path on
both sides, and the DevTools pipe (descriptors 3 and 4) is passed on to the host's Chrome
with flatpak-spawn --forward-fd=3 --forward-fd=4. Audio comes out of the host's Chrome, not
the app. The app's MPRIS name, org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.<its id>, is one Flatpak lets an app
own without asking. The Shell search provider's .ini and the D-Bus service file are
among the files Flatpak exports from share/ (gnome-shell/search-providers and
dbus-1/services, the service's Exec rewritten to flatpak run), so the overview's search
should reach the sandboxed app too. Written without a GNOME 50 runtime or
flatpak-builder to test it on: not built yet.
